services.name: Ash Scattering at Sea
services.desc: A funeral at sea offers a moving and dignified alternative to a conventional funeral. Down Cape Charters is proud to honor maritime traditions with our symbolic “End of Watch” tribute. Whether your loved one enjoyed ties to Cape Cod or simply felt a love for the sea, we hope our services can provide a level of comfort and closure during a very challenging and emotional time. SYMBOLIC “END OF WATCH” The striking of eight bells at noon harkens back to the days of sail, when time was kept by a trickle of sand through a half-hour glass. services.name: Nantucket Day Trip
services.desc: Let our captains whisk you away to Nantucket Island to walk the charming cobblestone streets, visit quaint shops and galleries, and dine at one of the “gray lady’s” many seaside restaurants. Your private boat and captain will drop you off in the middle of it all! From there passengers can explore independently, rent bikes or even sign up for a guided tour. Along our route we’ll encounter seals, lighthouses and the famed Monomoy National Wildlife Refuge. One way travel takes approximately 1.5 hours.
